chapters.10: Do you believe in words? As soon as you speak it, words have the power to make it happen.
chapters.13: One knows it is so precious, when one fears to lose it
chapters.16: Let me go under the deep of the sea, if it is a future of mine to live without you
chapters.4: We were given shapes each, when we were born. And live under it, trying to keep somehow. Till the end we melt away
chapters.7: Our Lord, please show me the beautiful world that thou had seen before
